name: manual_74321e
claim: For coordinated cross-repo publication, preserve historical cutoffs and append current qualifications; link unmerged records to their PR branches, test immutable dependency candidates as explicit overlays, and retain the production pin until merge. Commit logical batches, update each remote branch once with its expected head, and bind review replies and status comments to exact fixing SHAs.

decisions.notes: Orama #388, PT #430, Core #8 and Oramasys #23 use merge order docs/evidence then Core then application. Simultaneously resolving Oramasys's pinned Core and a candidate source correctly failed pip resolution; installing pinned dependencies then a no-deps candidate overlay passed the complete application suite. Tree-equivalent API publication must retain remote parent history and must not be confused with identical commit author identity or merged state.
